name: Tofu Frankie Roll
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 1 tsp frankie masala or ½ tsp each garam masala, chaat masala and chilli powder
Shredded cabbage and sliced onion, to serve
steps: Heat the oil, add the onion and capsicum and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the tofu and spices and cook for 5 minutes until dry and well coated. Finish with lemon juice.
Warm the rotis. Spread each with mint chutney.
Fill with the tofu mixture, cabbage and onion.
Roll up tightly and serve warm.
note: About 24 g protein per roll with whole-wheat wrap fibre.
